description: User-selectable model ids accepted by OpenAI's Codex CLI via the ChatGPT OAuth path. The CLI fetches its model catalog from chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex, which is a separate endpoint from the general OpenAI API. Source: codex-rs/models-manager/models.json in the openai/codex repo; internal-only codex-auto-review is intentionally omitted. gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.4-mini moved to visibility "hide" on 2026-07-14 ("Migrate GPT-5.4 uses to GPT-5.6 variants") — still accepted when named explicitly, but no longer offered in the model picker.
